course.description:
• We'll cover Science, Maths, Social Science, English( course A and B ), Hindi( Course A and B ), Sanskrit and IT for class 9th and 10th students.
  • Live lectures will be conducted, and in case you miss a session, recordings will be available to students in the Next Toppers app/website.
  • Classes will be scheduled according to your school timings.
  • There will be two classes per day, each lasting 1 hour 30 mins,  timings will be shared in orientation session.
  • Every fifth class will be a dedicated doubt-solving session.
  • A weekly schedule will be provided for your convenience.
  • Class notes will be provided in PDF format after each class on the Next Toppers App/website.
  • Tests will be conducted to assess your progress.
  • Classes will commence on 1st December 2025 and the syllabus will be completed by mid January.
  • The entire course will remain accessible to you until your exams in 2026.
  • English, Hindi, Sanskrit and IT will be given recorded.
  • This course is not refundable and noncancelable
